title: Subjunctive in prohibitions
subtitle: Read μὴ + subjunctive as a prohibition or warning.
overview: μή commonly negates non-indicative forms. With an aorist subjunctive it can prohibit an action without itself creating a complete theory of duration.
Read the whole exhortation: audience, contrast, and reason determine its practical force.

items.en: Let not your heart be troubled.

items.grc: μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον.
items.en: Do not suppose that I came to abolish the law.
